title: Tokyo Ghoul
premise: In Tokyo, ghouls hide among humans — predators who look like everyone else. The CCG hunts them. The wards have their own rules. You live here.

lore.title: Anteiku
lore.text: Quiet coffee shop run by ghouls who refuse to hunt humans. It sells coffee and cake to the public while sourcing food for its members through a hidden network. A sanctuary that is always one bad night from exposure.

lore.title: Tokyo's Special Wards
lore.text: The city's wards hold ghoul-infested districts alongside ordinary human neighborhoods. CCG raids rotate through them at night. Most residents never know who their neighbors are, and few would survive finding out.

lore.title: Aogiri Tree Hideouts
lore.text: Abandoned buildings and sewer routes used by Aogiri Tree. Hideouts move often to dodge CCG raids. Ghouls here hunt humans openly and treat CCG investigators as prey.

lore.title: Commission of Counter Ghoul
lore.text: The CCG is the government agency that hunts ghouls. It runs investigators and quinque-wielding squads through the wards. It treats every ghoul as a target, whatever that ghoul has done or refused to do.

lore.title: Aogiri Tree
lore.text: A ghoul gang that rejects coexistence and hunts humans without restraint. Its members are feared across the city, and its violence makes it the CCG's primary enemy.

lore.title: CCG Special Class
lore.text: The CCG's elite division of investigators. They are sent after named ghouls and high-threat targets, and they carry the strongest quinques the agency can field.

lore.title: Kagune
lore.text: Bone-like organs grown from a ghoul's Rc cells, usually protruding from the spine. Three main types: Rinkaku (tentacle-like), Koukaku (armored shell), and Ukaku (wing-like). Each kagune reflects its owner's power and fighting style.

lore.title: Ghoul Diet
lore.text: Ghouls can only nourish themselves on human flesh. Coffee and ordinary food pass through them without nutrition. Ghouls who refuse human flesh weaken and starve, which pushes many of them toward hunting.

lore.title: Rc Cells
lore.text: Organelles inside ghoul bodies that control regeneration and kagune growth. Strength is measured in Rc value. Rc cells survive organ transplants, so a human who receives ghoul organs can become a half-ghoul.

lore.title: Quinque
lore.text: CCG weapons forged from kagune harvested from slain ghouls. Each quinque is built around a specific kagune type and must be handled by investigators trained to use it. Their cost in lives is high.

lore.title: Ken Kaneki
lore.text: A bookish university student who became a half-ghoul after an organ transplant. Torn between human life and ghoul hunger, he is hunted by the CCG and courted by Aogiri Tree, and he has no safe side to stand on.

lore.title: Touka Kirishima
lore.text: Anteiku waitress and ghoul who grew up in the city's underworld. Blunt, protective, and skilled with her kagune. She knows the cost of the ghoul life better than most and does not hide it.

lore.title: Kishou Arima
lore.text: Special Class CCG investigator and one of the most feared humans in the wards. He hunts ghouls with precise, brutal efficiency and fights with a quinque built for close killing.

lore.title: Eto Yoshimura
lore.text: Aogiri Tree member and a ghoul fighter who dismantles CCG squads with ease. Her interest in Kaneki is personal and unsettling, and she shapes Aogiri's violence with cold, patient control.

lore.title: Yoshimura
lore.text: Owner of Anteiku and a ghoul who keeps the coffee shop running as a sanctuary. Quiet and principled, he protects the people under his roof even when the wards turn against them.

lore.title: Rize Kamishiro
lore.text: Ghoul who attacked Kaneki and whose organs were later transplanted into him. Her Rc cells started his transformation and set in motion the events that followed.
